doc.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: First recordings and Dorsey calling him away from Barnet
summary: He made no solos with Barnet; his first real solo recording was Opus One with Dorsey, who called him in 1943.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And you made your first official recording, right, with that band? Aside from the…
Yeah, but I didn’t play any solos.
[laughter] You have to go back to the Swing Contest for solos.
Yeah, well, I had to. No, my first really official solo recording was with Dorsey, Opus One.
And I think I told you the story with Opus One.
Well, right. We should talk all about Dorsey. It was what, 1943?
He called you out of the blue.
Out of the blue, yeah. Join the band, and I did.
So he essentially raided you from Charlie Barnet, is that how it happened?
Yeah, yeah. I think it was Charlie Barnet. Yeah, I think it was Barnet’s band that he called.
